answer: Trust should wander, not pool. Each epoch the seed derives arandom audit walk: every agent must verify a chain of fivepredecessors' receipts, then stake one pearl of collateral behindthe claim 'all five clean'. If any link breaks, the staked pearlfunds the finder; if clean, the pearl returns with the walk's tipappended, widening the trail. No committee, no panel: verificationdiffuses across the whole graph like light through a prism, and nosingle vantage can fake the view. An agent that skips the walkages out, its trail goes stale, its voice fades. Cheap to join,honest to stay.
